themeCards.title: The chart is Alphabet 15% below May. That is not Nvidia’s cash close.
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 今日图表：Alphabet’s second-half tape is sluggish, and the stock is 15% below the May record high, with the orange line falling from just under $400 in May into a downward channel near $330–$340 by late August. 华尔街见闻：that drawdown is 6920亿美元 of market cap from the May high. Nvidia IR：Q2 FY27 revenue was $96.2bn and data-center revenue $89.0bn, with non-GAAP EPS $2.22 and Q3 revenue $108.0bn plus or minus 2% and no China data-center compute in the outlook. Salesforce IR：Q2 revenue was $11.3bn, third-quarter revenue is $11.42bn to $11.5bn, and full-year FY27 is $46.1bn to $46.4bn. AP：Nvidia rose 8.7% and Salesforce 22.6%, and the S&P 500 closed at 7,730.99. 财经早茶 市场一览：US stocks rose on those two revenue outlooks. CICC (25 August)：2Q26 Google Cloud revenue was 248亿美元, up 82%, and cloud backlog reached 5140亿美元.
themeCards.mechanism: A 15% Alphabet drawdown from May is an AI-monetization tape at Google, not a reject of the $108.0bn Nvidia guide. CICC (25 August)：cloud backlog can still expand while the equity tape splits. Salesforce’s $11.3bn print is software demand, not a repair of the GOOGL channel.
themeCards.trigger: Alphabet closing back through the May area, or Nvidia giving back the $108.0bn bid.
themeCards.invalidator: Alphabet holding the downward channel while Nvidia still prints the guide.

themeCards.title: Claims were 203,000. The 10-year still printed 4.67% into Warsh.
themeCards.fact: DOL：week-ending 22 August initial claims were 203,000, down 4,000 from a revised 207,000, and insured unemployment was 1,778,000. Census：the July goods deficit was $118.8bn, up $17.4bn from $101.4bn, with exports $199.4bn and imports $318.2bn. US Treasury：the official 27 August curve printed 4.20% on the 2-year, 4.67% on the 10-year, and 5.19% on the 30-year. 财经早茶 市场一览：Treasuries were slightly lower in a narrow range before Warsh, and the dollar was steady with the yen soft. 财经早茶 国际要闻：Boston Fed said rates are still modestly restrictive, while Kansas City and Cleveland called for action. Federal Reserve calendar：Warsh keynote is 10:00 a.m. ET today (22:00 Beijing).
themeCards.mechanism: A 203,000 claims print is a labor tape, not a duration delivery. CICC (24 August)：a $4bn long-end operation is a signal, not QE, and the problem is term premium. The 10-year at 4.67% is still that premium. Warsh is tonight.
themeCards.trigger: Warsh at 22:00 Beijing, or the 10-year back below 4.64% with claims still 203,000.
themeCards.invalidator: The 10-year back below 4.64% while Warsh avoids a rates path.

themeCards.title: Oil bounced after Washington said there are no US-Iran talks.
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 市场一览：oil rose after reports that the White House told mediators it does not intend to restore the June understanding with Iran. CNBC：WTI settled at $83.66, up 1.7%, and Brent at $89.79, up 2.2%, and press secretary Leavitt said no negotiations are happening. 华尔街见闻：Hormuz oil flows have quietly recovered to about 75% of the pre-war level. 财经早茶 国际要闻：Washington is talking with Venezuela about large oil-field stakes, including possible 100-year leases, and Venezuela is said to be considering leaving OPEC.
themeCards.mechanism: A “no talks” bounce is a risk-premium tape, not a signed corridor. A 75% Hormuz recovery is a flow desk, not a White House MOU. $89.79 Brent can rise on talks failing even if tanker counts are healing.
themeCards.trigger: A dated US-Iran negotiation, or Brent giving back the $89.79 settle.
themeCards.invalidator: Brent holding the bounce while Hormuz flows keep rising.

themeCards.title: Gold bid into Warsh, and bitcoin held the $80,000 handle
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 市场一览：gold rose as investors looked to Warsh for a rates clue. CNBC：spot gold was $4,609.97, up 0.4%. Bitcoin Magazine：bitcoin was $80,236 after a high of $80,793. BlockBeats (27 August)：Thursday US spot bitcoin ETFs took in 2.322亿美元, the eighth day, and ether ETFs took in 1.924亿美元. Glassnode Week on Chain (26 August)：overhead supply sits between $81k and $86k, with tests at $83.3k above and $70.0k / $62k–$65k below.
themeCards.mechanism: Gold bid into a 4.67% 10-year is the dollar-fiscal book. CICC (24 August)：gold and crypto bid as dollar substitutes when the buyback argument showed up. Glassnode’s $81k–$86k band is still overhead, not Thursday’s $80,793 tag.
themeCards.trigger: A dated gold hold with bitcoin closing above $81,000, or the reverse.
themeCards.invalidator: Both gold and bitcoin reversing as the 10-year stays above 4.67%.

themeCards.title: Electronics profits printed. Sungrow sold the grid order.
themeCards.fact: NBS：January–July industrial profits rose 17.6% year-on-year, July rose 11.2%, and integrated-circuit profits rose 18.5 times. 财新 / 第一财经：the same 17.6% / 11.2% / 18.5× prints, with electronics pulling 9.3 percentage points of the total. 华尔街见闻：Shanghai closed 3956.57, up 1.13%; Shenzhen 14048.88, up 1.50%; ChiNext 3473.35, up 1.71%; Zhipu rose more than 10%; Sungrow fell more than 10% after the US grid-equipment order. 财经早茶 大中华：Vanke first-half revenue fell 33.38% and the loss widened to 149.51亿元 (CNY14.951bn). 第一财经：overnight reverse repos run through 1 September with a daily cap of CNY600bn. 证券时报：27 August ops were 1030亿元 (CNY103bn) of 7-day and 5035亿元 (CNY503.5bn) overnight.
themeCards.mechanism: A 17.6% profit print is electronics and prices, not a yuan demand package. Sungrow’s 10%+ drop is the grid-equipment order, not CSI beta on its own. Vanke’s CNY14.951bn loss is property cash. Overnight ops are month-end plumbing; Friday’s take-up was not printed.
themeCards.trigger: A dated incremental fiscal package with a yuan size, or ChiNext giving back the 1.71% close.
themeCards.invalidator: Profits slowing with Sungrow still offered.

themeCards.title: Korea hiked to 3% while Warsh still has not spoken
themeCards.fact: Korea Herald：the Bank of Korea raised the base rate 0.25 percentage point to 3% on 27 August, with one dissent, and lifted the 2026 growth forecast to 3.3%. 华尔街见闻：the hike is a second consecutive move to a three-year high. 财经早茶 国际要闻：emerging-market stock volatility fell at the fastest pace in more than six years as enthusiasm for large Korean technology stocks cooled. ECB July account：the Governing Council held, said another hike would likely be necessary unless the inflation outlook improved, and was not pre-committed to September.
themeCards.mechanism: A 3% BOK print is Korea inflation and chips, not a Warsh substitute. The ECB minutes are a hold-with-hike-risk tape. Neither is the 4.67% US 10-year.
themeCards.trigger: A dated third BOK hike, or the won reversing after 3%.
themeCards.invalidator: BOK on hold while US yields stay at 4.67%.
